title: Why $12,000 at 18 Quietly Beats $44,400 at 28
summary: Two 18-year-olds, same job, same $100 a month. One puts in less than a third as much and still ends up ahead. Here are 7 money moves that make time work for you, with every number shown. Figures are examples at assumed 7% and 5% yearly returns (and 3% inflation), not predictions. Maya and Jordan are fictional composites.
sources: Credit card rate source: Federal Reserve G.19, August 2026 (22.36% on accounts assessed interest): https://www.federalreserve.gov/releases/g19/current/default.htm
